Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing certain tax exemptions to provide funding for essential government services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repealing certain tax exemptions to providefunding for essential government services; creating a new section; andrepealing RCW 82.08.0272, 82.12.0272, 82.08.910, 82.12.910, 82.08.920,and 82.12.920.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the economiccrisis has impacted the many Washington families which do not earnenough annually to keep pace with increasing health care, child care,and workrelated expenses. The legislature further finds that revenuesare insufficient to maintain necessary funding for education, publicsafety, health care, and safety net services for elderly, disabled, andvulnerable people during the unprecedented economic crisis in the 20112013 fiscal biennium. Therefore, it is the intent of the legislatureto provide a means to stabilize revenue collections by repealingcertain nonessential tax exemptions.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: p. 1 SB 5947 RCW 82.08.0272 (ExemptionsSales of semen for artificialinsemination of livestock) and 1980 c 37 s 38; RCW 82.12.0272 (ExemptionsUse of personal property in singletrade shows) and 2009 c 535 s 616 & 1980 c 37 s 70; RCW 82.08.910 (ExemptionsPropane or natural gas to heatchicken structures) and 2001 2nd sp.s. c 25 s 3; RCW 82.12.910 (ExemptionsPropane or natural gas to heatchicken structures) and 2001 2nd sp.s. c 25 s 4; RCW 82.08.920 (ExemptionsChicken bedding materials) and 20012nd sp.s. c 25 s 5; and RCW 82.12.920 (ExemptionsChicken bedding materials) and 20012nd sp.s. c 25 s 6.
